title: Class timetable
description: Weekly group classes and their sessions: day, time, trainer, area and seats. A group class can be booked only at its sessions.
forbidden: You are not allowed to view the class timetable.
load_failed: The timetable could not be loaded.
timetable_hint: Each row repeats a class every week; every such day between its start and end dates is a session.
empty_description: Build the timetable by placing your group services on weekdays and times.
empty_filtered_description: Change the search or filters and try again.
delete_description: The class leaves the timetable and its future sessions can no longer be booked. If future sessions have bookings, cancel or move them first.
dialog.description: Place a group service on a weekday and time. With no trainer or area, the first booking of each session picks a free one.
fields.service_hint: Only services with a group capacity are listed.
fields.staff_hint: The trainer needs no shift, but must be free at that time.
fields.staff_empty: Nobody teaches this class in the branch.
fields.resource_hint: The studio, hall or area of the class.
fields.resource_empty: No suitable area in the branch.
fields.capacity_hint: Empty uses the service's group capacity: {{seats}}.
fields.capacity_hint_empty: Empty uses the service's group capacity.
fields.is_active_hint: Sessions of an inactive class cannot be booked.
fields.valid_until_hint: Day of the last session; empty runs with no end.
validation.note: The note can be at most 500 characters.
validation.reason: The reason can be at most 500 characters.
errors.not_group: This service is not a group class; give it a group capacity.
errors.not_offered: The branch does not offer this class.
errors.staff_not_allowed: This class runs without a trainer.
errors.not_qualified: This person does not teach the class.
errors.staff_not_in_branch: This person does not work in the branch.
errors.staff_busy: The trainer has another class on that day and time.
errors.resource_not_in_branch: The area belongs to another branch.
errors.kind_mismatch: The class does not use this kind of area.
errors.resource_busy: The area has another class on that day and time.
errors.duplicate: This class already runs in the branch on that day and time.
errors.before_from: The end date cannot be before the start date.
errors.has_bookings: Some sessions have bookings; cancel or move them first.
errors.below_booked: Seats cannot go below the seats booked.
errors.past: A session that started or passed cannot be changed.
sessions.hint: Sessions of the chosen days and their seats. Pending requests hold seats too.
sessions.empty_description: Add classes to the weekly timetable or pick other days.
session.title: Session
session.description: Seats, attendees and attendance of the session.
session.attendees_hint: Attended completes the booking and No-show marks it; payments and packages follow as for any booking.
session_dialog.cancel_description: Only this day's session is cancelled; the timetable stays. The trainer and area are free at that time.
session_dialog.seats_description: Only this session's seats change. {{booked}} seats are booked now.
session_dialog.restore_description: The session can be booked again. If the trainer or area is busy at that time, it cannot be booked.
session_dialog.cancel_bookings_descripti: The session is cancelled and its {{count}} bookings are cancelled in one step. Customers get the cancellation notice; seats and package sessions are freed and payments taken wait for their refund. You can undo it on this page within 24 hours.

The session is cancelled and the bookings of its {{booked}} booked seats are cancelled in one step. Customers get the cancellation notice; seats and package sessions are freed and payments taken wait for their refund. You can undo it on the session page within 24 hours.
session_dialog.undo_description: The session opens again and the cancelled bookings are taken back; customers are told their booking stands. Bookings changed meanwhile, whose time is taken, whose package has no session left or whose product is out of stock stay cancelled.
toast.session_cancelled_partial: Session cancelled; {{succeeded}} of {{total}} bookings cancelled. You can cancel the rest on the session page.
toast.cancel_undone: Cancellation undone; the session and its bookings are open again
toast.cancel_undone_partial: Cancellation partly undone; some bookings stay cancelled
move_dialog.title: Move bookings to another session
move_dialog.description: The {{count}} open bookings of this session are moved to the chosen session of the same class in one step. Customers are told their booking was updated; package sessions are kept while the validity allows. Bookings that find no seat stay in this session and are listed. You can undo it on this page within 24 hours.
move_dialog.target_hint: Open sessions of the same class within 31 days from today.
move_dialog.no_target: No open session to move to
move_dialog.undo_description: The moved bookings come back to this session; customers are told their time was updated. Bookings changed meanwhile or whose seat is taken stay in the target session.
errors.to_date_same_session: The target cannot be this session itself.
errors.to_date_not_found: The class has no session on that day.
errors.to_date_past: The target session has started or passed.
errors.to_date_full: The target session has no seat left.
errors.has_bookings_sessions: Sessions with bookings: {{dates}}. Move them to another session with Move bookings on the session page, or cancel them.
toast.bookings_moved_partial: {{succeeded}} of {{total}} bookings moved; {{left}} stayed in this session.
toast.move_undone: Move undone; the bookings are back in this session
toast.move_undone_partial: Move partly undone; some bookings stay in the target session
